blind.table_distance_name: interior wall section with window and wood wainscoting
blind.description: A freestanding modular wall segment featuring a multi-pane vertical window. The interior front side has rich brown wood wainscoting panels along the lower half, a wood window frame with 8 small panes (translucent off-white glass), a beige/tan plaster upper portion, and a molded crown trim on top. The reverse side (exterior or unpaneled interior) is a plain textured tan/beige plaster surface with the window set in flush. Surfaces are fully solid, continuous, and clean, sitting flat on the ground on its integrated wood baseboard.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow beige rectangle with slightly beveled edges and a faint protruding molding profile along one long edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 ft tall) and about 4 ft wide.
